passages.text: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband’s side, a prominent man of noble character from the clan of Elimelech, whose name was Boaz.
passages.sermon:
Naomi had a relative on her husband's side.
This man was from the clan of Elimelech.
He was a prominent man.
He had noble character.
His name was Boaz.
passages.original: וּֽלְנָעֳמִ֞י מְיֻדָּע לְאִישָׁ֗הּ אִ֚ישׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל מִמִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ וּשְׁמ֖וֹ בֹּֽעַז׃

passages.text: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.” “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Naomi was her mother-in-law.
Ruth spoke to Naomi.
Ruth said, “Please let me go to the field.”
Ruth wanted to gather leftover grain.
She planned to follow after someone who would show her kindness.
Naomi answered Ruth.
Naomi said, “Go, my daughter.”
passages.original: וַתֹּאמֶר֩ ר֨וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶֽל־ נָעֳמִ֗י אֵֽלְכָה־ נָּ֤א הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וַאֲלַקֳטָּ֣ה בַשִׁבֳּלִ֔ים אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֑יו וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ לְכִ֥י בִתִּֽי׃

passages.text: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters. And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from the clan of Elimelech.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth left Naomi’s house.
Ruth went out to the fields.
Ruth followed after the harvesters.
Ruth gathered leftover grain.
Ruth came to a certain part of the field.
This part of the field belonged to Boaz.
Boaz was a prominent man.
Boaz was from the clan of Elimelech.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶךְ וַתָּבוֹא֙ וַתְּלַקֵּ֣ט בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֖י הַקֹּצְרִ֑ים וַיִּ֣קֶר מִקְרֶ֔הָ חֶלְקַ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ לְבֹ֔עַז אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֱלִימֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.” “The LORD bless you,” they replied.
passages.sermon:
Boaz was a relative of Elimelech.
Boaz came from Bethlehem.
Boaz arrived at the field.
Boaz saw the harvesters working.
Boaz spoke to the harvesters.
Boaz said, “The LORD be with you.”
The harvesters answered Boaz.
They said, “The LORD bless you.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּה־ בֹ֗עַז בָּ֚א מִבֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לַקּוֹצְרִ֖ים יְהוָ֣ה עִמָּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖וֹ יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?”
passages.sermon:
Boaz was a wealthy man from the clan of Elimelech.
Boaz owned the field where Ruth was gleaning.
Boaz saw a young woman in his field.
Boaz spoke to the foreman who managed his harvesters.
Boaz asked the foreman a question.
Boaz said, “Who is this young woman?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בֹּ֙עַז֙ לְנַעֲר֔וֹ הַנִּצָּ֖ב עַל־ הַקּֽוֹצְרִ֑ים לְמִ֖י הַנַּעֲרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.
passages.sermon:
The foreman stood over the harvesters.
He answered Boaz.
He said, “She is a young woman from Moab.
She returned with Naomi.
She came from the land of Moab.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֗עַן הַנַּ֛עַר הַנִּצָּ֥ב עַל־ הַקּוֹצְרִ֖ים וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נַעֲרָ֤ה מֽוֹאֲבִיָּה֙ הִ֔יא הַשָּׁ֥בָה עִֽם־ נָעֳמִ֖י מִשְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב׃

passages.text: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
passages.sermon:
Ruth is a Moabite woman.
She returned from Moab with Naomi.
Ruth spoke to the foreman of the harvesters.
She said, “Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.”
Ruth came to the field in the morning.
She has been standing and working here from morning until now.
She rested in the shelter for only a short time.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֲלַקֳטָה־ נָּא֙ וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י בָֽעֳמָרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י הַקּוֹצְרִ֑ים וַתָּב֣וֹא וַֽתַּעֲמ֗וֹד מֵאָ֤ז הַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וְעַד־ עַ֔תָּה זֶ֛ה שִׁבְתָּ֥הּ הַבַּ֖יִת מְעָֽט׃

passages.text: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.
passages.sermon:
Boaz spoke to Ruth.
Boaz was a wealthy and respected man in Bethlehem.
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth had returned from Moab with Naomi.
Boaz said, "Listen, my daughter."
He said, "Do not go to another field to gather grain."
He said, "Do not leave this place."
He said, "Stay here close to my servant girls."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶל־ ר֜וּת הֲל֧וֹא שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ בִּתִּ֗י אַל־ תֵּלְכִי֙ לִלְקֹט֙ בְּשָׂדֶ֣ה אַחֵ֔ר וְגַ֛ם לֹ֥א תַעֲבוּרִ֖י מִזֶּ֑ה וְכֹ֥ה תִדְבָּקִ֖ין עִם־ נַעֲרֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.”
passages.sermon:
Boaz spoke to Ruth.
Boaz was a wealthy and respected man in Bethlehem.
Ruth was a foreign woman from Moab.
Boaz said, “Watch the field where the workers are harvesting.
Follow behind the young women who work for me.
I have told the young men not to touch you.
If you are thirsty, go to the jars.
Drink from the water the young men have drawn.”
passages.original: עֵינַ֜יִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְצֹרוּן֙ וְהָלַ֣כְתִּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן הֲל֥וֹא צִוִּ֛יתִי אֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים לְבִלְתִּ֣י נָגְעֵ֑ךְ וְצָמִ֗ת וְהָלַכְתְּ֙ אֶל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְשָׁתִ֕ית מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁאֲב֖וּן הַנְּעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: At this, she fell on her face, bowing low to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?”
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a foreign woman in Israel.
Boaz spoke kindly to her.
Ruth heard Boaz’s words.
Ruth fell on her face.
She bowed low to the ground.
She spoke to Boaz.
She asked him a question.
She said, “Why have I found favor in your eyes?”
She said, “Why do you notice me?”
She said, “I am a foreigner.”
passages.original: וַתִּפֹּל֙ עַל־ פָּנֶ֔יהָ וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָה וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו מַדּוּעַ֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ לְהַכִּירֵ֔נִי וְאָּנֹכִ֖י נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.
passages.sermon:
Boaz spoke to Ruth.
Boaz said, “People told me everything you did for your mother-in-law.
You did these things after your husband died.
You left your father.
You left your mother.
You left the land where you were born.
You came to a people you did not know before.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַן בֹּ֙עַז֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔הּ הֻגֵּ֨ד הֻגַּ֜ד לִ֗י כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂית֙ אֶת־ חֲמוֹתֵ֔ךְ אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ וַתַּֽעַזְבִ֞י אָּבִ֣יךְ וְאִמֵּ֗ךְ וְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔ךְ וַתֵּ֣לְכִ֔י אֶל־ עַ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדַ֖עַתְּ תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

passages.text: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
passages.sermon:
Boaz spoke to Ruth.
Boaz was a respected man in Bethlehem.
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth had shown kindness to her mother-in-law Naomi.
Ruth had left her homeland to live among the people of Israel.
Boaz said, “May the LORD repay you for your work.”
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Boaz said, “May you receive a full reward from the LORD.”
Boaz said, “You have come to take refuge under His wings.”
passages.original: יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה פָּעֳלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֨י מַשְׂכֻּרְתֵּ֜ךְ שְׁלֵמָ֗ה מֵעִ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖את לַחֲס֥וֹת תַּֽחַת־ כְּנָפָֽיו׃

passages.text: “My lord,” she said, “may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.”
passages.sermon:
Ruth spoke to Boaz.
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth had left her homeland and family.
Ruth had come to Israel with her mother-in-law Naomi.
Ruth said, “My lord, may I continue to find favor in your eyes.
You have comforted me.
You have spoken kindly to your maidservant.
I am not like one of your servant girls.”
passages.original: וַ֠תֹּאמֶר אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֨ן בְּעֵינֶ֤יךָ אֲדֹנִי֙ כִּ֣י נִֽחַמְתָּ֔נִי וְכִ֥י דִבַּ֖רְתָּ עַל־ לֵ֣ב שִׁפְחָתֶ֑ךָ וְאָנֹכִי֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽהְיֶ֔ה כְּאַחַ֖ת שִׁפְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come over here; have some bread and dip it into the vinegar sauce.” So she sat down beside the harvesters, and he offered her roasted grain, and she ate and was satisfied and had some left over.
passages.sermon:
Boaz was a wealthy and kind man in Bethlehem.
Boaz spoke to Ruth at mealtime.
He said, “Come here.”
He invited Ruth to eat bread.
He told her to dip her piece of bread in the vinegar sauce.
Ruth sat down beside the harvesters.
Boaz gave Ruth some roasted grain.
Ruth ate the food.
She was satisfied.
She had some food left over.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ לָ֨ה בֹ֜עַז לְעֵ֣ת הָאֹ֗כֶל גֹּ֤שִֽׁי הֲלֹם֙ וְאָכַ֣לְתְּ מִן־ הַלֶּ֔חֶם וְטָבַ֥לְתְּ פִּתֵּ֖ךְ בַּחֹ֑מֶץ וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ מִצַּ֣ד הַקּֽוֹצְרִ֔ים וַיִּצְבָּט־ לָ֣הּ קָלִ֔י וַתֹּ֥אכַל וַתִּשְׂבַּ֖ע וַתֹּתַֽר׃

passages.text: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
She was poor and a foreigner.
She got up to gather leftover grain in the field.
Boaz was a wealthy and kind landowner.
Boaz saw Ruth.
Boaz spoke to his young men.
Boaz gave them an order.
He said, “Let Ruth gather grain even among the sheaves.
Do not insult her.”
passages.original: וַתָּ֖קָם לְלַקֵּ֑ט וַיְצַו֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶת־ נְעָרָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ין הָֽעֳמָרִ֛ים תְּלַקֵּ֖ט וְלֹ֥א תַכְלִימֽוּהָ׃

passages.text: Rather, pull out for her some stalks from the bundles and leave them for her to gather. Do not rebuke her.”
passages.sermon:
Boaz was a wealthy and kind landowner in Bethlehem.
Boaz spoke to his young men who worked for him.
Boaz gave them instructions about Ruth, a Moabite woman who was gleaning in his field.
Boaz said, “Pull out some stalks of grain from the bundles for her.
Leave these stalks on the ground for Ruth to gather.
Do not scold her.
Do not rebuke her.”
passages.original: וְגַ֛ם שֹׁל־ תָּשֹׁ֥לּוּ לָ֖הּ מִן־ הַצְּבָתִ֑ים וַעֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם וְלִקְּטָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִגְעֲרוּ־ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: So Ruth gathered grain in the field until evening. And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
She was the daughter-in-law of Naomi.
Ruth went to the field.
She gathered grain there.
She worked until evening.
She beat out the grain she had gathered.
The grain was about an ephah of barley.
passages.original: וַתְּלַקֵּ֥ט בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וַתַּחְבֹּט֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ לִקֵּ֔טָה וַיְהִ֖י כְּאֵיפָ֥ה שְׂעֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: She picked up the grain and went into the town, where her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. And she brought out what she had saved from her meal and gave it to Naomi.
passages.sermon:
Ruth picked up the grain she had gathered.
She went into the town.
Naomi was her mother-in-law.
Naomi saw what Ruth had gleaned.
Ruth had saved some food from her meal.
Ruth brought out the food she had saved.
Ruth gave the food to Naomi.
passages.original: וַתִּשָּׂא֙ וַתָּב֣וֹא הָעִ֔יר וַתֵּ֥רֶא חֲמוֹתָ֖הּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ לִקֵּ֑טָה וַתּוֹצֵא֙ וַתִּתֶּן־ לָ֔הּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹתִ֖רָה מִשָּׂבְעָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the man who noticed you.” So she told her mother-in-law where she had worked. “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,” she said.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Naomi was her mother-in-law.
Naomi spoke to Ruth.
Naomi asked Ruth, “Where did you gather grain today?”
Naomi also asked, “Where did you work?”
Naomi said, “May the man who noticed you be blessed.”
Ruth told Naomi about the man she worked with.
Ruth said, “The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz.”
passages.original: וַתֹּאמֶר֩ לָ֨הּ חֲמוֹתָ֜הּ אֵיפֹ֨ה לִקַּ֤טְתְּ הַיּוֹם֙ וְאָ֣נָה עָשִׂ֔ית יְהִ֥י מַכִּירֵ֖ךְ בָּר֑וּךְ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד לַחֲמוֹתָ֗הּ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשְׂתָה֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שֵׁ֤ם הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֧יתִי עִמּ֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם בֹּֽעַז׃

passages.text: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living or the dead.” Naomi continued, “The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers.”
passages.sermon:
Naomi spoke to her daughter-in-law Ruth.
Naomi said, “May the LORD bless this man.”
Naomi said, “The LORD has not stopped showing kindness.”
The LORD shows kindness to the living and to the dead.
Naomi also said, “This man is a close relative to us.”
Naomi said, “He is one of our kinsman-redeemers.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר נָעֳמִ֜י לְכַלָּתָ֗הּ בָּר֥וּךְ הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־ עָזַ֣ב חַסְדּ֔וֹ אֶת־ הַחַיִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמֵּתִ֑ים וַתֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣הּ נָעֳמִ֗י קָר֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ מִֽגֹּאֲלֵ֖נוּ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, “He also told me, ‘Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth spoke.
Ruth said, "He also told me something."
He is Boaz.
Boaz said to me, 'Stay with my young men.'
Stay with them until they finish gathering all my harvest.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר ר֣וּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּ֑ה גַּ֣ם׀ כִּי־ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֗י עִם־ הַנְּעָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ לִי֙ תִּדְבָּקִ֔ין עַ֣ד אִם־ כִּלּ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַקָּצִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, “My daughter, it is good for you to work with his young women, so that nothing will happen to you in another field.”
passages.sermon:
Naomi was Ruth’s mother-in-law.
Naomi spoke to Ruth.
Naomi said, “My daughter, it is good for you to go out with his young women.”
Naomi said, “If you stay with his young women, no one will harm you in another field.”
passages.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר נָעֳמִ֖י אֶל־ ר֣וּת כַּלָּתָ֑הּ ט֣וֹב בִּתִּ֗י כִּ֤י תֵֽצְאִי֙ עִם־ נַ֣עֲרוֹתָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִפְגְּעוּ־ בָ֖ךְ בְּשָׂדֶ֥ה אַחֵֽר׃

passages.text: So Ruth stayed close to the servant girls of Boaz to glean grain until the barley and wheat harvests were finished. And she lived with her mother-in-law.
passages.sermon:
Ruth was a Moabite woman.
Ruth stayed with the servant girls of Boaz.
She gathered leftover grain with them.
She did this until the barley harvest ended.
She also did this until the wheat harvest ended.
Ruth lived with her mother-in-law Naomi.
passages.original: וַתִּדְבַּ֞ק בְּנַעֲר֥וֹת בֹּ֙עַז֙ לְלַקֵּ֔ט עַד־ כְּל֥וֹת קְצִֽיר־ הַשְּׂעֹרִ֖ים וּקְצִ֣יר הַֽחִטִּ֑ים וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב אֶת־ חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃
